description: This Java class handles the creation of standing instructions in the Financial Services application. It is a command handler that receives a JSON command and delegates the creation process to the relevant service.

classes.name: CreateStandingInstructionCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles commands to create standing instructions by invoking the write platform service.

methods.name: CreateStandingInstructionCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor injecting the standing instruction write platform service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the command to create a standing instruction by delegating to the service.
